expected.insightNarrative:
Profitability KPI tracks the profitability of a shipping business per shipment and per company: by knowing which companies bring the most or least profit, better decisions can be made about which to keep. The story is three customers bringing three quarters of the profit, one of them, Eliza Software, at an unusually high margin, and a few shipments whose discounts wipe out their profit.

Key insights
- Eliza Software stands out with an average profit ratio per shipment of 36.9%, far above every other company; the lowest ratios belong to Endova Corp (7.9%), Aqua LLC (8.3%) and Blue Heron (8.9%).
- Anova (25.7% of profit), Eliza Software (25.5%) and Spirit Soda (23.3%) bring about three quarters of the total profit.
- The deepest discounts in the shipment detail are on two Firebright shipments (-$593 on shipment 991918 with a pay amount of $1,178 and -$328 on 991324), a Koncept shipment (-$539 on 997312, pay amount $1,960) and two Anova shipments (-$275 on 991435 and -$256 on 992032).

Profitability
Profitability per shipment as a scatter plot of profit ratio per shipment against profit, with each shipment rated GOOD (blue), OK (orange) or BAD (red). Most shipments sit between $0 and $2,000 of profit with ratios below 100%; a handful reach $2,000 to $6,000 of profit, two shipments exceed a 400% ratio, and the BAD shipments cluster at or below $0 profit with negative ratios.

Profitability by Company
The share of total profit and the profit ratio by company, sorted by share, with a search box for a shipment ID and click-to-filter. Anova (25.7%, ratio 20.4%), Eliza Software (25.5%, 36.9%) and Spirit Soda (23.3%, 16.1%) bring three quarters of the profit; Firebright (5.5%), Accent on Style (3.8%) and Kyle Industries (3.7%) follow; the remaining companies, from Viktoria's (2.8%) down to Blue Heron (0.0%), each contribute under 3%, with the lowest ratios at Endova Corp (7.9%), Aqua LLC (8.3%) and Blue Heron (8.9%).

Profitability Details
A table of shipments for the selected customer (Accent on Style): shipment ID, pay amount and a set of rating flags per shipment, with pay amounts from $324.94 to $1,050.
